# Golden fixtures

Generated by `tests/golden/generate_yitong_goldens.m` by running the frozen
copy of Yitong's code in `tests/yitong_reference`. Do not edit them by hand.
Each file's `provenance` records:

- the generator's git commit;
- the SHA-256 of `MANIFEST.tsv`;
- the MATLAB and toolbox versions;
- every non-MathWorks file that was loaded while the section ran, with its hash.

| Fixture | What it pins | Inputs |
|---|---|---|
| `yitong_session_inputs` | Extracts from his own sessions: the 2025-03-08 reference image, ordered `cell_coord`, DMD registration and z position; the 2024-08-23 ROIs and masks for both patterns | `data&notes` (read-only), source hashes recorded |
| `yitong_matrix` | The 320×320 stimulation matrix from the script's own lines | none |
| `yitong_blue` | `linearize_blue_voltage` over 0–5 V, plus edge values | his `blueCal.mat` |
| `yitong_segmentation` | `static_image_seg_v5` output and ordering, his `n_exclude` (5), the `minVal` curve, the tied-maxima failure | session image, plus `synthetic_reference_image` |
| `yitong_masks` | Auto Square (size 5) and `reduce_spot_size_sequence(3)` ROIs and masks; canonical 2025 geometry; `spot_select_sequence` masks | session inputs |
| `yitong_waveforms` | Stimulation and scan DAQ waveforms, run-length encoded, sample-exact | his settings and channel list |
| `yitong_drift` | `square_target_drift_correction_v4`: new ROIs and masks, Z move, restored settings, ALP calls | canonical geometry; synthetic drift scan and z-stack |
| `yitong_trace` | His protocol script, trials 1–640: every acquisition's settings, DMD queue and cell selection; motor moves; final state | canonical geometry; synthetic drift and bleaching |
| `yitong_reconstruction` | `dmd_hadamard_reconstruct` and `hadamard_reconstruct` | `synthetic_hadamard_movie` |
